# agent/v1

An app asks a language model for an answer: classify a record, pull JSON out of text, summarize, write a title. App
code calls the same thing wherever the app runs; who answers is the provider's business:

- **the app's own API:** any OpenAI-compatible endpoint and key the app's admins set (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, a
  local Ollama or llama-server);
- **a model PocketOne runs itself,** named in `pocketone.yaml`, downloaded once and cached;
- **its host's model:** a multisite host may provide this contract for its instances, running one model they all share
  unless an instance's admins set their own API.

A wire contract at `/api/_c/agent/v1` ([agent.go](https://github.com/pockethost/pocketone/blob/main/ext/contracts/agent/v1/agent.go)), one provider. The [agent](/docs/extensions/agent/extension)
extension provides it.

## Use

From `pb_hooks`:

```js
onRecordCreate((e) => {
  const r = $agent.complete({
    system: "Label the support ticket.",
    prompt: e.record.get("body"),
    schema: { type: "object", properties: { label: { enum: ["bug", "billing", "question"] } }, required: ["label"] },
    maxTokens: 30,
  })
  e.record.set("label", r.data.label)
  e.next()
}, "tickets")
```

Over HTTP (a superuser, or a token with the `agent` scope):

| Operation | HTTP | Token scope |
|---|---|---|
| Complete | `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/complete` with `{"prompt": "...", "maxTokens": 100}` | `agent` |
| Stream | `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/stream`, same input; server-sent events | `agent` |
| Status | `GET /api/_c/agent/v1` | `agent:read` |
| Warm | `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/warm` with `{"system": "...", "wait": "30s"}` | `agent` |
| Forget | `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/forget` with `{"id": "w_..."}` | `agent` |
| Count | `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/count` with `{"text": "..."}` or `{"system": "...", "messages": [...]}` | `agent:read` |
| Threads | `GET /api/_c/agent/v1/threads` | `agent:read` |
| Forget a thread | `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/threads/forget` with `{"id": "..."}` | `agent` |

`complete` takes `prompt` or `messages` (`[{"role": "user", "content": "..."}]`), and optionally `system`, `schema` (a
JSON schema the answer must match; its parsed value comes back as `data`), `maxTokens`, `temperature`, `stop` and `model` (a hint a
single-model provider ignores), `thread` (a conversation's name: the provider keeps the model's state after the call
and continues from it when the next call starts the same way, so it reads only what's new; a cache, not storage) and
`wait` (how long to wait for a loading model, as a duration; without it a loading model fails at once). It answers `text`, `data`, `model`, `backend` (`app`, `runner` or `host`),
`stopReason` and `usage` (`inputTokens`, `outputTokens`, and `cachedTokens`: how much of the prompt came from a
cache of an earlier prompt that started the same way). Errors: `not_configured` (503), `not_ready` (503, still downloading or loading), `busy`
(429, the app already has as many calls going as its host allows).

`stream` sends the same answer as it's written: one `event: stream` per piece, `{"text": "..."}`, then
`{"done": true, "result": {...}}` with what `complete` returns. An error before the answer starts is a JSON error
response; one during it ends the stream with `event: error`. In the same process, `$agent.stream(opts, onText)` runs it
with a callback (from Go, call the returned `extkit.Stream`'s `Run`).

`status` says which backend and model answer, and whether the model is ready (with download progress).

`warm` reads the start of later prompts ahead of them (a preamble, say) and keeps it in the prompt cache until
`forget`: calls that start the same way skip reading it. It returns at once with `{"id", "warmed": false}` and warms in
the background, unless `wait` says how long to wait for it. The id is the same for the same text on the same app (not
per model: the provider warms it again after a model change). A provider without a prompt cache (an app's own API,
which caches prompts itself) answers `warmed: false` with a message, never an error.

`count` gives a text's or a conversation's tokens (`exact: false` when the provider can only estimate). `threads`
lists the threads whose state is kept (`id`, `tokens`, `bytes`, `where`: memory or disk, `usedAt`).

From Go: `agentv1.Contract.Must(app).Complete(ctx, extkit.Internal, agentv1.CompleteInput{...})`.

## Provide

Implement `agentv1.Agent` and provide it in `Register` (`agentv1.Contract.Provide(app, a)`), or on a host for every
instance (`agentv1.Contract.ProvideForInstances(hostScope, func(id string) agentv1.Agent {...})`). A host's provider
should honor the instance's own API settings, so its admins can leave the shared model without changing code, and
keep each instance's warms, threads and prompt cache apart from every other instance's.

## Commands and APIs

Every operation is a REST endpoint, a `pocketone` command and an MCP tool, all generated from the contract and behind the same token scope check and hooks. See [Remote CLI](/docs/features/remote), or the full [CLI](/docs/reference/cli), [REST](/docs/reference/rest) and [MCP](/docs/reference/mcp) references.

### complete

Answers a prompt or a conversation with the app's language model.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/complete` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote agent complete --system <value> --prompt <value> --messages <json> --schema <json> --maxtokens <n> --temperature <json> --stop <a,b> --model <value> --thread <value> --wait <value>` |
| MCP | `agent_complete` |
| Token scope | `agent` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `system` | `--system` | string |
| `prompt` | `--prompt` | string |
| `messages` | `--messages` | json |
| `schema` | `--schema` | json |
| `maxTokens` | `--maxtokens` | int |
| `temperature` | `--temperature` | json |
| `stop` | `--stop` | strings |
| `model` | `--model` | string |
| `thread` | `--thread` | string |
| `wait` | `--wait` | string |

### stream

Answers like Complete, sending the answer as it's written: a chunk with text for each piece, then one with done and the whole result.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/stream` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote agent stream --system <value> --prompt <value> --messages <json> --schema <json> --maxtokens <n> --temperature <json> --stop <a,b> --model <value> --thread <value> --wait <value>` |
| MCP | `agent_stream` |
| Token scope | `agent` |
| Answer | a stream of JSON entries (server-sent events); the command prints one line each |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `system` | `--system` | string |
| `prompt` | `--prompt` | string |
| `messages` | `--messages` | json |
| `schema` | `--schema` | json |
| `maxTokens` | `--maxtokens` | int |
| `temperature` | `--temperature` | json |
| `stop` | `--stop` | strings |
| `model` | `--model` | string |
| `thread` | `--thread` | string |
| `wait` | `--wait` | string |

### status

Says which model answers the app's prompts and whether it's ready.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/_c/agent/v1` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote agent status` |
| MCP | `agent_status` |
| Token scope | `agent:read` |

### warm

Reads the start of prompts ahead of the calls that use it (a preamble, say), so they skip reading it. It returns at once with the warm's id and warms in the background, unless Wait says how long to wait for it. The id is the same for the same text on the same app, so warming again is cheap. A provider without a prompt cache returns Warmed false.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/warm` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote agent warm --system <value> --messages <json> --prompt <value> --wait <value>` |
| MCP | `agent_warm` |
| Token scope | `agent` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `system` | `--system` | string |
| `messages` | `--messages` | json |
| `prompt` | `--prompt` | string |
| `wait` | `--wait` | string |

### forget

Releases a warm: its text may leave the cache like any other.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/forget` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote agent forget --id <value>` |
| MCP | `agent_forget` |
| Token scope | `agent` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `--id` | string |

### count

Says how many tokens a text or a conversation is for the app's model, for budgeting what to send.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/count` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote agent count --text <value> --system <value> --messages <json>` |
| MCP | `agent_count` |
| Token scope | `agent:read` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `--text` | string |
| `system` | `--system` | string |
| `messages` | `--messages` | json |

### threads

Lists the conversations whose model state the provider keeps for the app (CompleteInput.Thread).

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/_c/agent/v1/threads` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote agent threads` |
| MCP | `agent_threads` |
| Token scope | `agent:read` |

### forget_thread

Drops a thread's kept state, in memory and on disk.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/_c/agent/v1/threads/forget` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote agent forget-thread --id <value>` |
| MCP | `agent_forget_thread` |
| Token scope | `agent` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `--id` | string |
